tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Bounding $\mu $ by the scalar curvature and volume ratio] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0403 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-perelman-invariants 1. appD:D.45\group Volume Ratios

For every ball $B(p,r)$ in a closed Riemannian manifold, \[ \mu (\hat g,r^2)\leq \log \frac{\operatorname {Vol}B(p,r)}{r^n} +\left(36+\frac{r^2\int _{B(p,r)}R_+\, d\mu }{\operatorname {Vol}B(p,r)}\right) \frac{\operatorname {Vol}B(p,r)}{\operatorname {Vol}B(p,r/2)}, \] where $R_+=\max \{ R,0\} $.
